blocks.text: Fits the raw model into box, a Box3's corners as three.js writes them (meters, before scale): one uniform scale grows or shrinks the model until it meets the box's nearest side, and scale then multiplies that size. The corners size the model and never move it. An axis the box leaves out is…

LayoutSpec = { box?: { min?: { x?: number; y?: number; z?: number }; max?: { x?: number; y?: number; z?: number } } // The box's corners, `{ min: { x, y, z }, max: { x, y, z } }`, as a three.js Box3 holds them. }
